# Sarah

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Sarah is a small person who dresses in shabby black garments. She has thin cheeks.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063)_

## History

Twenty years prior, Sarah liked Luther Wallace, but her father turned him away because he was poor. Sarah was also forced by her family to whitewash an old duckhouse every spring. After [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) crashed through the roof of this duckhouse, Sarah freed her with an axe, hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea, and agreed to sell [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars to help save money for her upcoming marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P57](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0057), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P59](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0059), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P60](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0060), +3 more_
